commitMessage:
Explanations behind (i) buttons on every module

- Every settings and report page gets an (i) next to its title (top bar
  on phones, above the content on desktop) that opens a short
  description of the module
- Relation fields on the Connections pages show their explanation
  behind an (i) beside the field instead of always-visible helper text
- Always-visible info notes on Subscriptions, Resellers and Connections
  moved behind the (i) buttons
